chapter_seo_title: Sima Lan (Ch. 378): Li Huowang Infiltrates the Supervisory Heavenly Office
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang enters the Supervisory Heavenly Office and learns of the Mohist split, a moldy intelligence spider, and the self-selection assignment system that could be his key to finding the North Wind.
og_title: The Moldy Bureaucracy: Li Huowang's First Day at the Supervisory Heavenly Office
og_description: In a hall of shadowy screens and a decaying bamboo intelligence network, Li Huowang takes his first active steps toward manipulating the Office to hunt the North Wind.
twitter_title: Dao-Twisted Chapter 378: Learning the Office's Moldy Ropes
twitter_description: Li Huowang gets a crash course in Mohist politics, a tour of a fungal intelligence hub, and the key to choosing his own assignments.

lore_anchors.definition: The novel’s imperial supernormal law enforcement body; a bureaucratic entity that polices rogue cultivators and supernatural disasters.
An ancient Chinese philosophical school founded by Mozi, emphasizing universal love, meritocracy, and frugality; in the novel, it has split into orthodox (Qi) and heretical (Liang) branches.
The orthodox branch of the Mohist school, which remained loyal to the original teachings of the Grand Master and the Great Liang Empire.
A heretical branch of Mohism that twisted the original doctrines, allied with the Eastern Quake Hall (东震堂), and became monstrous.
A faction aligned with the heretical Liang Mohism; its name implies a sect tied to the trigram for “Thunder” (震).
An official title in the Office responsible for registering new members and managing watch assignments.
The Chief Recorder’s informal name, mentioned by Nangong; Li Huowang notes the connection.
